name: Side Neck Stretch
instructions: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder.
Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.
prompt: This is a Side Neck Stretch for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the neck. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder. Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head."
